name: Fat Mule 63
author: amralashi
description: Gradient rounded dark purple button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes from linear-gradient(135deg, #800080, #ffc0cb, #0000ff, #00ffff) to linear-gradient(100deg, #800080, #ffc0cb, #0000ff, #00ffff).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Fat Mule 63</title>
<style>
/* Fat Mule 63 by amralashi — https://uiverse.io/amralashi/fat-mule-63 */
button {
  width: 10rem;
  height: 3rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, purple, pink, blue, aqua);
  border-radius: 3rem;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: white;
  border: none;
}

button:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, purple, pink, blue, aqua);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
